shadowbolt.name: Shadow Bolt
shadowbolt.desc: Main Shadow nuke with a cast time.

demonskin.name: Demon Skin
demonskin.desc: Self buff: armor and health regen for 30 min. Demon Armor replaces it at 20.

summonimp.name: Summon Imp
summonimp.desc: Summons your Imp (fire caster, Blood Pact).

immolate.name: Immolate
immolate.desc: Fire hit plus a burn over 15 sec.

shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.desc: Wand attack; the warlock's free filler. Not a warlock spell, needs a wand.

corruption.name: Corruption
corruption.desc: Shadow damage over time. Damage-over-time effects can crit in Forever.

curseofweakness.name: Curse of Weakness
curseofweakness.desc: Curse: reduces the target's physical damage. One Curse per warlock per target.

lifetap.name: Life Tap
lifetap.desc: Turns health into mana. Scales with Spirit in Forever.

baneofagony.name: Bane of Agony
baneofagony.desc: Bane: ramping Shadow damage over 24 sec. Was Curse of Agony; in Forever it is a Bane, so it stacks with your Curse.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: Makes one target run in fear; damage may break it.

createhealthstone.name: Create Healthstone
createhealthstone.desc: Conjures a Healthstone (instant heal item, bind the stone too).

drainsoul.name: Drain Soul
drainsoul.desc: Channel that gives Soul Shards. Forever: shard chance rises every tick until guaranteed.

summonvoidwalker.name: Summon Voidwalker
summonvoidwalker.desc: Summons your Voidwalker tank. Costs a Soul Shard.

healthfunnel.name: Health Funnel
healthfunnel.desc: Channel your health into your demon.

curseofrecklessness.name: Curse of Recklessness
curseofrecklessness.desc: Curse: lowers armor; the target won't flee or obey Fear.

drainlife.name: Drain Life
drainlife.desc: Channel that steals health from the target.

unendingbreath.name: Unending Breath
unendingbreath.desc: Lets a friendly target breathe underwater for 10 min.

createsoulstone.name: Create Soulstone
createsoulstone.desc: Conjures a Soulstone: use it on a target so they can resurrect after dying.

searingpain.name: Searing Pain
searingpain.desc: Fast Fire nuke with high threat.

ritualofsummoning.name: Ritual of Summoning
ritualofsummoning.desc: Opens a portal that summons a group member; needs 2 helpers to click it.

summonsuccubus.name: Summon Succubus
summonsuccubus.desc: Summons your Succubus (Seduction, Lash of Pain). Class quest at 20.

summonincubus.name: Summon Incubus
summonincubus.desc: Summons an Incubus, the male counterpart of the Succubus with the same abilities. New in Forever (separate class quest).

demonarmor.name: Demon Armor
demonarmor.desc: Self buff: armor, Shadow resistance and health regen. Replaces Demon Skin.

curseoftheelements.name: Curse of the Elements
curseoftheelements.desc: Curse: lowers all magic resistances and raises magic damage taken. Forever: all schools, learned at 20 (was 32), new icon and ids.

eyeofkilrogg.name: Eye of Kilrogg
eyeofkilrogg.desc: Summons a scouting eye and moves your view to it.

drainmana.name: Drain Mana
drainmana.desc: Channel that steals mana from the target.

sensedemons.name: Sense Demons
sensedemons.desc: Tracking: shows demons on the minimap.

curseoftongues.name: Curse of Tongues
curseoftongues.desc: Curse: slows the target's casting by 50%.

detectinvisibility.name: Detect Invisibility
detectinvisibility.desc: Lets a friendly target see invisible units. Forever folds Lesser/normal/Greater into one spell with ranks (26, 38, 50).

createfirestone.name: Create Firestone
createfirestone.desc: Conjures a Firestone. Forever: using it puts a Fire imbue on your weapon (stacks with oils).

banish.name: Banish
banish.desc: Takes a demon or elemental out of the fight for up to 20 sec.

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.desc: Channeled Fire AoE around you that also burns you.

summonfelhunter.name: Summon Felhunter
summonfelhunter.desc: Summons your Felhunter (Spell Lock, Devour Magic). Class quest at 30.

subjugatedemon.name: Subjugate Demon
subjugatedemon.desc: Takes control of a demon for up to 5 min. Enslave Demon renamed in Forever.

shadowward.name: Shadow Ward
shadowward.desc: Self shield that absorbs Shadow damage for 30 sec.

createspellstone.name: Create Spellstone
createspellstone.desc: Conjures a Spellstone. Forever: using it puts a Shadow damage and haste imbue on your weapon.

summonfelsteed.name: Summon Felsteed
summonfelsteed.desc: Summons your warlock mount. Class quest at 40.

howlofterror.name: Howl of Terror
howlofterror.desc: AoE fear on up to 5 nearby enemies.

deathcoil.name: Death Coil
deathcoil.desc: Instant Shadow hit that horrifies the target for 3 sec and heals you.

soulfire.name: Soul Fire
soulfire.desc: Huge, slow Fire nuke. Costs a Soul Shard.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Calls an Infernal down on an area, stunning enemies; it fights for you for 5 min. Outdoors only.

ritualofdoom.name: Ritual of Doom
ritualofdoom.desc: Group ritual (caster + 4) that summons a Doomguard and sacrifices a participant.

baneofdoom.name: Bane of Doom
baneofdoom.desc: Bane: big Shadow hit after 1 min; may summon a Doomguard if it kills. Was Curse of Doom; can't be cast on players.

summondreadsteed.name: Summon Dreadsteed
summondreadsteed.desc: Summons your epic warlock mount. Class quest at 60.

amplifycurse.name: Amplify Curse
amplifycurse.desc: Boosts your next Curse of Weakness, Bane of Agony or Curse of Exhaustion.

curseofexhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curseofexhaustion.desc: Curse: slows the target by 30% for 12 sec. Forever: a 16-point Affliction talent, stronger slow.

siphonlife.name: Siphon Life
siphonlife.desc: Drains health from the target over 30 sec.

wrack.name: Wrack
wrack.desc: Channeled Shadow damage that makes your Corruption, Bane of Agony and Siphon Life tick faster. New in Forever (31-point Affliction talent).

demonicsacrifice.name: Demonic Sacrifice
demonicsacrifice.desc: Sacrifices your demon for a 2-hour buff that depends on the demon. Reworked in Forever (11-point talent).

feldomination.name: Fel Domination
feldomination.desc: Your next demon summon is 6 sec faster and costs half mana. Forever: 16-point talent, 5 min cooldown.

soullink.name: Soul Link
soullink.desc: Your demon takes 30% of your damage taken; you both deal 3% more. Forever: 21-point talent.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.desc: Instant Shadow hit; refunds a shard if the target dies soon. Costs a Soul Shard.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.desc: Instant Fire hit that needs and consumes your Immolate. Forever: 16-point talent with new ranks at 25 and 32.

baneofhavoc.name: Bane of Havoc
baneofhavoc.desc: Bane on one target: 15% of your damage to other targets also hits it, for 5 min. New in Forever (21-point talent).

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.desc: Fire nuke with a 2.5 sec cast; 25% more if the target has Immolate. New in Forever (31-point Destruction talent).

petattack.name: Attack
petattack.desc: Sends your demon to attack your target.

petfollow.name: Follow
petfollow.desc: Calls your demon back to follow you.

petdefensive.name: Defensive
petdefensive.desc: Demon attacks what attacks you or it.

petpassive.name: Passive
petpassive.desc: Demon never attacks on its own.

petbloodpact.name: Blood Pact
petbloodpact.desc: Party Stamina aura. Improved Imp no longer boosts it in Forever.

petphaseshift.name: Phase Shift
petphaseshift.desc: The Imp phases out and can't be attacked unless it attacks.

petfireshield.name: Fire Shield
petfireshield.desc: Puts a Fire damage shield on a party member (not on the Imp).

petsacrifice.name: Sacrifice
petsacrifice.desc: Kills the Voidwalker to give you a damage shield.

petsoothingkiss.name: Soothing Kiss
petsoothingkiss.desc: Lowers the Succubus' threat on the target.

petseduction.name: Seduction
petseduction.desc: Crowd control on a humanoid for up to 15 sec; damage breaks it.

petlesserinvisibility.name: Lesser Invisibility
petlesserinvisibility.desc: Makes the demon invisible out of combat.

petdevourmagic.name: Devour Magic
petdevourmagic.desc: Dispels a debuff from a friend or a buff from an enemy and heals the Felhunter.

pettaintedblood.name: Tainted Blood
pettaintedblood.desc: Melee attackers of the Felhunter lose attack power.

petspelllock.name: Spell Lock
petspelllock.desc: Silence and interrupt. Improved Felhunter (Forever talent) cuts its cooldown.
